metadata.title: Farhadifar, Röper, Aigouy, Eaton & Jülicher (2007) Current Biology Drosophila Wing Disc Epithelial Vertex Model, Lewis's Law & Polygon-Class Reference Dataset
metadata.organism: Drosophila melanogaster (3rd-instar larval wing imaginal disc & pupal wing epithelium)

sources.citation: Farhadifar R, Röper JC, Aigouy B, Eaton S, Jülicher F (2007). The influence of cell mechanics, cell-cell interactions, and proliferation on epithelial packing. Current Biology 17(24):2095-2104.
Gibson MC, Patel AB, Nagpal R, Perrimon N (2006). The emergence of geometric order in proliferating metazoan epithelia. Nature 442(7106):1038-1041.
Classen AK, Anderson KI, Marois E, Eaton S (2005). Hexagonal packing of Drosophila wing epithelial cells by the planar cell polarity pathway. Developmental Cell 9(6):805-817.
Nagai T, Honda H (2001). A dynamic cell model for the formation of epithelial tissues. Philosophical Magazine B 81(7):699-719.
Lewis FT (1928). The correlation between cell division and the shapes and sizes of prismatic cells in the epidermis of Cucumis. The Anatomical Record 38(3):341-376.

drosophila_wing_epithelium_specimen.species: Apical junction-stained polygonal epithelial monolayer (green tight/adherens junction network with DAPI nuclei exhibiting hexagonal/pentagonal/heptagonal packing)

farhadifar_2007_vertex_energy_functional.section: Farhadifar et al. (2007) Current Biology 17(24):2095-2104, Eq. (1) & Eq. (2), pp. 2096-2098
farhadifar_2007_vertex_energy_functional.dimensional_energy_formula: E({r_i}) = sum_alpha (K_alpha / 2) * (A_alpha - A_alpha^(0))^2 + sum_{<i,j>} Lambda_{ij} * l_{ij} + sum_alpha (Gamma_alpha / 2) * L_alpha^2

dimensionless_parameters.regular_hexagon_perimeter_formula: L_6(A) = 2 * sqrt(2 * sqrt(3)) * sqrt(A) = sqrt(8 * sqrt(3) * A)

canonical_wing_disc_parameters.notes: Fitted in Farhadifar et al. (2007) Fig. 2A & Fig. 4 from polygon distribution P(n), area-side law <A_n>/<A>, and UV laser ablation of adherens junctions in 3rd-instar Drosophila wing imaginal discs.

ground_state_phase_regimes.label: Case I: Proliferating Wing Disc (Solid-like Hexagonal Ground State + Division Disorder)
Case I: Post-Mitotic Pupal Wing (Junctional Remodeling Hexagonal Packing)
Case I: High Cortical Contractility (Stiffened Perimeter Elasticity)
Case II: Soft / Fluid-like Network (Negative Line Tension, Vanishing T1 Barrier)

polygon_class_distributions.section: Farhadifar et al. (2007) Current Biology Fig. 3B & Fig. 4B; Gibson et al. (2006) Nature Fig. 1; Classen et al. (2005) Dev. Cell Fig. 1

lewis_law_area_topology.section: Lewis (1928) Anat. Rec. 38:341-376; Farhadifar et al. (2007) Current Biology Fig. 3C & Fig. 4C
